page.overview:
Who is Faceless?

Faceless is a character who appears in the G.I. Joe Roleplaying Game by Renegade Game Studios. He is used as a part of the introductory adventure, Snake Pit.

Faceless is a Cobra Officer. Formerly Cobra Commander's personal courier, he fell out of his employer's good graces and fled the organization. However, as he fled, he pocketed a package intended for the Commander that just happened to include the location of The Pit.

As a way to get back into Cobra Commander's favor, he has assembled a small team known as Scar Squad. His plan is to infiltrate the Pit, sabotage it and steal the G.I. Joe team's confidential data.

Elements of Faceless' character; being a Cobra Officer, serving as Cobra Commander's courier and infiltrating The Pit, are similar to Scar-Face
